entries: Qunbraxel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) psychic damage. headerEntries: The refraction casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

trait.name: Creature Sense
entries: The refraction is aware of creatures within 100 miles of it that have an Intelligence score of 4 or higher. It knows the distance and direction to each creature, as well as each one's Intelligence score, but can't sense anything else about it. A creature protected by a {@spell mind blank} spell, a {@spell nondetection} spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The refraction can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the refraction fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The refraction has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one creature. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) psychic damage. If the target is a creature {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, its {@status concentration} is broken.

action.name: Mind Blast {@recharge 5}

action.name: Teleport
entries: The refraction teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied place that it can see.

legendary.name: Mindbreaker

legendary.name: Projected Claw (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The refraction makes one Dissonant Claw attack.

entries: If Aerisi fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.
